notes.text: Available in cPanel 104 and later; operates on the selected cPanel account. Omitted optional arguments, including null, remain omitted; explicit empty strings, false and zero are sent according to their parameter types. No client-side defaults are substituted.

Creates the team user and returns an integer Unix expiration timestamp, not a nullable object. Supply either password or activation_email; activation_email=1 sends an email allowing the team user to set a password. The client does not enforce this cross-parameter condition or send a message independently. Password is sensitive and stays in the form POST body.

roles is a comma-separated string; this operation rejects the singular role parameter. A team user without roles cannot use any features. Adding a team user can grant team owner level privileges. notes must not contain private information and is documented with a 100-character maximum.

expire_date is an integer Unix Epoch Time or a string offset such as 120days. The response is the resulting integer Unix timestamp. Optional service flags default to 0 upstream; Web Disk permissions default to rw. Email quota is a string in MB; 0 or unlimited means unlimited and the system maximum still applies. Omitting quota retains the defined system value.

A subaccount is always created, without service subaccounts by default. FTP and Web Disk home directories are relative to the cPanel account home. The FTP directory must exist; the source says its homedir parameter is required if services.ftp.homedir is enabled, a self-referential condition retained without inventing client validation. Web Disk homedir is required when Web Disk is enabled. Web Disk private selects 0700 versus public 0755. Digest authentication is discouraged and only documented for compatibility on certain Windows clients with self-signed cpsrvd/cpdavd certificates.

Upstream flag defaults are 0 and Web Disk permissions default to rw; omitted arguments are not filled in by this client. Password is sensitive. notes must not contain private information.

set_expire accepts an integer epoch or a string day offset; add_role, remove_role and set_role remain strings. Email quota is in MB as a string; 0 or unlimited means unlimited, defaults to the system value, and cannot exceed the system maximum.

FTP and Web Disk directories are relative to the account home; the FTP directory must exist. The source repeats a self-referential FTP homedir requiredness condition, so no cross-field validation is inferred. Web Disk homedir is required when enabled. private chooses 0700 versus 0755. Digest authentication is discouraged and documented only for certain Windows compatibility with self-signed cpsrvd/cpdavd certificates.
